intro.zh: 先定一台摄影机作唯一基准：上传 FBX / USD 摄影机，或用 ViPE / COLMAP / VidMap / Depth Anything 3 Streaming 求。再打开要的功能：场景点云、简模、高斯场景、匹配人、3D 跟踪点、镜头畸变。每个功能都经「摄影机空间转换」搬进这台摄影机的世界，交付物放进 DCC 天然重合；求摄影机时可地面落地。摄影机一定交付（USD / FBX / Nuke），另交一份合在一起的场景 USD；关掉的功能整条不算。
intro.en: First set one camera as the single reference: upload an FBX / USD camera, or solve with ViPE / COLMAP / VidMap / Depth Anything 3 Streaming. Then turn on what you need: scene point cloud, simple mesh, Gaussians, matched people, 3D tracks, lens distortion. Each is moved into this camera's world, so everything lines up in your DCC. The camera is always delivered (USD / FBX / Nuke) with one combined scene USD.

label.zh: 地面落地（场景转正、地面落到 y=0）
